result.summary: CORRECTION: the prior report's acceptance covered Server reconciliation and Activity accounting only; the Founder's Training Day presentation acceptance FAILED because the four reconciled Cardio walks are missing from Sep23/Sep24 Training Day (Sep21 control shows two Outdoor Walk rows + Strength; Activity Day is accounting-only and needs no rows). Root cause PROVEN by running the deployed Training Day store query + createTrainingDayReadModel over production data read-only: Training Day is built only from canonical training EVIDENCE objects; the Sep20-22 walks are screenshot-derived evidence objects, while the reconciled Sep23/24 walks are canonical HealthKit workouts in a separate collection that Training Day never read. Canonical data is valid (identical structure to the Sep22 canary; Sep22's two HealthKit walks are recorded as duplicates of the screenshot walks, so naive addition would double-show). A minimal Server-only fix adapts canonical Cardio workouts into the existing row shape (presentation only: no Logger/link/claim/strategic change, generic Walking stays generic, Indoor/Outdoor only from stored canonicalType, active-evidence dedup with live coexistence reassessment, Activity-parity gate, established captured_at ordering form). On real production data the candidate turns Sep23/Sep24 into Walking, Walking, Strength while Sep20/21/22/25 stay byte-identical. 24 new tests, 10 mutations RED, Part F 71/71, broad failures identical to production, webpack build passes, two fresh-context reviews PASS-WITH-NOTES. Candidate a399916a; Native needs no change (no Build 61); NOT deployed.

tests.summary: 24 new Training Day Cardio tests, Part F 71/71, broad Server failures identical to clean production (none new), production webpack build on the exact SHA.

review.summary: Two fresh-context adversarial reviews (79b2e9d2 then exact final a399916a): PASS-WITH-NOTES, no blocking; review-1 findings (superseded evidence vanish, late-screenshot double-show, cycle classification, silent catch, looser gate) fixed and confirmed closed.

zero_write_audit.summary: All production access was BEGIN REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY and rolled back; nothing was mutated or deployed.

decisions_required: Authorize the Server-only deploy of candidate a399916a (fast-forward the production branch, then the two-step apps update --spec + create-deployment --force-rebuild); no Native build is needed.
Optional follow-up scope: unify Training landing/history/reporting/library counts with reconciled Cardio (they still read only evidence collections).
unexpected_findings: Training Day ordering is by the string captured_at (Logger Strength sessions store a T12:00:00Z placeholder), not workout start time; reconciled Cardio rows use workout-local time with offset to match the established Sep 21 order.
Sep22's two canonical HealthKit walks duplicate the screenshot walks (coexistence matches_existing_evidence_workout), so presenting canonical Cardio requires duplicate suppression.
Other Training surfaces (landing, reporting, library, rollups) still omit reconciled Cardio.
backlog: Founder deployment authorization for Server candidate a399916a, then re-verify Sep23/Sep24 Training Day on device.
Prospective Indoor/Outdoor type-fidelity acceptance on the first new post-activation Cardio workout.
